novel_features.name: Ops/run history log
novel_features.description: See exactly which commands this CLI has run, whether each succeeded, and whether Resolve was too busy and had to be retried.

novel_features.name: Cross-project marker search
novel_features.description: Find a marker by text across every project this CLI has touched, not just the one currently open in Resolve.

novel_features.name: Cross-project render history & delivery audit
novel_features.description: See every render this CLI has ever queued across all projects, with the actual output file verified against the requested spec.

novel_features.name: Grade-version drift audit across projects
novel_features.description: See which timelines are still on an old color grade version across your whole project library, not just the one open in Resolve.

novel_features.name: Fusion/Title content catalog & search
novel_features.description: Find what text was used in a past Text+/title, across every project, without reopening it.

novel_features.name: Timeline edit-log / operation history
novel_features.description: See the full append/delete history for one timeline — the only record of what actually changed, since Resolve has no undo API.

novel_features.name: Doctor environment-drift history
novel_features.description: See whether this machine's Resolve/Python environment has drifted since yesterday, not just whether it's healthy right now.
